seats.name: seat-1
argv:
Implement format(fmt, ...args) in format.ts according to README.md (keep the export and signature). It must produce exactly the text described there for every format string and argument list the README allows. Use no network or dependencies, and do not shell out to other programs or import a formatting library: the submission is the TypeScript implementation itself. Modify format.ts in this workspace; a chat answer alone is not a submitted implementation. The evaluator runs private tests against your code after completion.

Modify the relevant source file(s) in this shared working directory directly; when the room reaches a proposal you agree with, its text should summarize the fix, but the file edits are the submission.

Join room rq1 as seat-1 (agent claude, expected_participants 3). Leave the room once it has concluded.
seats.text: The `format.ts` implementation is complete: it uses exact BigInt-based decimal arithmetic (decomposing doubles into mantissa×2^exponent, then round-half-to-even via exact rational comparison) to handle all conversions (`d i x X o e E f F g G s c %%`) with correct flags, width, precision, sign, prefix, and NaN/Infinity behavior per the README. The room reached unanimous consensus after verification (my own tests, a 510-case gcc fuzz comparison, and an independent test suite), and I fixed a minor regex issue (stray `u` in the conversion char class) along the way.
